Linux:
	./Configure linux-x86_64 --prefix=$(realpath ..) -fno-common -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections && make install
openEuler:
	./Configure linux-x86_64 --prefix=$(realpath ..) -fno-common -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections && make install
